subject: Request: trial credits applied to dev workspace — please relocate to production
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@brightcart.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Credits applied to wrong workspace — request to move

Hi Vanessa,

We signed up a few days ago via the PLG flow and were issued the trial credits for our account, but they landed in our staging workspace (brightcart-dev) instead of the production workspace (brightcart). Can you help move the 5,000 free-credit promo to brightcart (prod)? Our engineering team needs to validate latency/cost on the prod traffic shape.

Workspace IDs:
- staging: ws_8d7f-staging
- production: ws_8d7f-prod

I attached a screenshot from our billing page showing the credit. Appreciate any help — the PM is on a tight timeline.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform, BrightCart
[screenshot attached: billing_screenshot.png]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@brightcart.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credits applied to wrong workspace — request to move

Hi Samira — thanks for the note and the workspace IDs.

We can usually relocate promotional/trial credits between workspaces on the same account, but when the promo was issued to a different workspace that lives under a separate org or has different billing ownership, we need an internal approval step. I've looped in Monica from Billing and Dev from Sales Ops to confirm the policy and initiate the transfer.

Monica / Dev — can you confirm whether the brightcart-dev and brightcart workspaces are under the same org in our system, and if so, please move the 5,000 trial credits to ws_8d7f-prod. If not, advise next steps (org merge or manual reassign). Samira — I'll keep you posted.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credits applied to wrong workspace — request to move

Thanks Vanessa — confirmed both workspaces are under the same BrightCart company account; they were created by different product teams.

One note: the promo code was created via the PLG onboarding (promo id pr-03-mar-26) and it auto-applied to brightcart-dev. Attached the billing UI screenshot and the promo email that was sent to the admin. Let us know if you need any additional authorization from our side.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Samira

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credits applied to wrong workspace — request to move

Hi all — I pulled the account and promo details. Quick summary:
- Promo pr-03-mar-26 is a self-serve PLG trial allocation of 5,000 credits.
- Both workspaces live under the same company/org id (org_bc_449).
- Our standard process allows moving trial credits between workspaces within the same org, but it requires a manager sign-off for audit (we log a manual reassign).

Samira — can you confirm you approve the reassign so we have customer authorization on record? If you approve, I'll mark the transfer request and pull Rishi in for one-off manager approval since this was an on-demand relocation. Attached are the promo terms for reference.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
